programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.sub_title: Off Grid in the North Woods - Part 1
programs.desc: The Cabin Masters head deep into the woods in northern Maine to renovate a remote cabin; the team caravans in for a two-week build, facing rough roads and tight deadlines; this off-grid build was so ambitious, it had to be split into two parts!

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.sub_title: Off Grid in the North Woods -- Part 2
programs.desc: The Cabin Masters work to finish Nine Mile Camp; after whitewater rafting, Chase and the team build bunk beds, Dixie and Jedi design an archery target, and Ashley continues her quest for a bug-free build; can they get it all done in two weeks?

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: Converting the first post office ever built in Manchester, Maine, into an off-the-grid cabin.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: The crew helps a couple turn their chopped up, suburban cabin into the spacious, rustic Maine getaway they've always wanted; with the help of some new faces and upgraded equipment, the Cabin Masters breathe new life into this family's retreat.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.desc: The Hamill family hope that Chase and the Cabin Masters can improve the livability of their rustic 1963 Mount Vernon cabin, which has no kitchen, bathroom or electricity.

programs.title: Maine Cabin Masters
programs.sub_title: It Takes a Village of People
programs.desc: Chase and Ashley rally the Cabin Masters to help build a new arts and crafts building; with no budget for the project, the Cabin Masters get help from the community to finish the build before the winter snow.

programs.title: Barnwood Builders
programs.sub_title: Wading With Alligators to Build a Two-Story Hunting Lodge in Florida
programs.desc: Mark and the guys transport a log home to Florida where they turn it into a hunting lodge; Mark makes mouth-blown glass for the windows, and he dives into an alligator pond to get some long-leaf pine for the floors.

programs.sub_title: Transforming a Shipping Container Into a Portable Barnwood Cabin
programs.desc: Mark and the crew use welding tools to turn a shipping container into a portable barn-wood cabin, then they load it onto a trailer.
